exclusions.name: mattermost
exclusions.reason: The Mattermost desktop app is published as "Mattermost" by Mattermost, Inc., the same name and publisher as the server, with its own version line. Accepted cost: server rows with that exact name and publisher are not matched by product title either.

exclusions.name: nextcloud
exclusions.reason: The Nextcloud desktop sync client is published as "Nextcloud" by Nextcloud GmbH, the same name and publisher as the server, with its own version line. Accepted cost: server rows with that exact name and publisher are not matched by product title either.

ansible.reason: Red Hat makes Ansible (Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform). Its CPE vendor is written as one word, redhat, which never equals the two words Red Hat.

ceph.reason: Debian's ceph source package names the maintainer "Ceph Packaging Team".

coder.reason: The winget manifest for Coder gives the publisher "Coder Technologies, Inc.".

commvault.reason: Commvault's legal page names the company Commvault Systems, Inc.

deno.reason: The winget manifest for Deno gives the publisher "Deno Land Inc.".

discourse.reason: The Discourse site names the copyright holder Civilized Discourse Construction Kit, Inc.

drupal.reason: The Drupal Association administers Drupal.org for the Drupal project, and is named as the publisher in catalog rows.

erlang.reason: The winget manifest for Erlang OTP gives the publisher "Ericsson AB". Debian's erlang source package names the maintainer "Debian Erlang Packagers" (https://sources.debian.org/data/main/e/erlang/1:25.2.3+dfsg-1+deb12u4/debian/control).

grafana.reason: The winget manifest for Grafana OSS gives the publisher "Grafana Labs", the company that makes Grafana.

haproxy.reason: HAProxy Technologies is the company behind HAProxy and is named on its site. Debian's haproxy source package names the maintainer "Debian HAProxy Maintainers" (https://sources.debian.org/data/main/h/haproxy/2.6.12-1+deb12u3/debian/control).

istio.reason: The Istio site footer reads "the Istio Authors", the copyright holder used in the project's files.

kubernetes.reason: The Kubernetes site footer reads "The Kubernetes Authors", the copyright holder used in the project's files.

libreoffice.reason: The winget manifest for LibreOffice gives the publisher "The Document Foundation". Debian's libreoffice source package names the maintainer "Debian LibreOffice Maintainers" (https://sources.debian.org/data/main/libr/libreoffice/4:7.4.7-1+deb12u14/debian/control).

mariadb.reason: The winget manifest for MariaDB Server gives the publisher "MariaDB Corporation Ab".

mediawiki.reason: Debian's mediawiki source package names the maintainer "MediaWiki packaging team".

nginx.reason: Debian's nginx source package names the maintainer "Debian Nginx Maintainers". The nginx.org Ubuntu package index (https://nginx.org/packages/ubuntu/dists/jammy/nginx/binary-amd64/Packages) names "NGINX Packaging".

openssl.reason: Debian's openssl source package names the maintainer "Debian OpenSSL Team".

openvpn.reason: Debian's openvpn source package (unstable) names the maintainer "OpenVPN Maintainers".

pgadmin.reason: The winget manifest for pgAdmin gives the publisher "The pgAdmin Development Team".

php.reason: The PHP license page names The PHP Group as the copyright holder of PHP. Debian's php-defaults source package names the maintainer "Debian PHP Maintainers" (https://sources.debian.org/data/main/p/php-defaults/93/debian/control).

phpmyadmin.reason: Debian's phpmyadmin source package names the maintainer "phpMyAdmin Packaging Team".

postgresql.reason: The winget manifest for PostgreSQL 16 gives the publisher "PostgreSQL Global Development Group"; the licence page at https://www.postgresql.org/about/licence/ uses the same name. Debian's postgresql-common source package names the maintainer "Debian PostgreSQL Maintainers" (https://sources.debian.org/data/main/p/postgresql-common/248+deb12u1/debian/control).

prometheus.reason: The Prometheus site footer reads "Prometheus Authors", the copyright holder used in the project's files.

puppet.reason: Debian's puppet-agent copyright file names the copyright holder "Puppet Labs Inc", the company's earlier name. Its control file (https://sources.debian.org/data/main/p/puppet-agent/7.23.0-1/debian/control) names the maintainer "Puppet Package Maintainers".

scala.reason: The Scala site names the copyright holder Ecole Polytechnique Federale Lausanne (EPFL).

sqlite.reason: The SQLite Consortium page on sqlite.org describes the consortium that funds SQLite development; catalog rows name it as the publisher.

telegraf.reason: The winget manifest for Telegraf gives the publisher "InfluxData Inc.".

traefik.reason: Traefik Labs is the company behind Traefik and is named on its site.

wireshark.reason: The winget manifest for Wireshark gives the publisher "The Wireshark developer community, https://www.wireshark.org".

zabbix.reason: The Zabbix contact page names the company Zabbix SIA.
